description: Modified housing inventory projection (mHIP) method is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Rachel Davidson, University of Delaware (udel.edu). This project estimates expected damages and economic losses from hurricane impact under different land use and building code scenarios over a 30-year time horizon in Eastern North Carolina. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tnqp-ag38. Keywords: hurricane, housing, land use, building codes. Published 2025-03-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
